categories.main_business_segments: ZTE Corporation operates primarily in the ICT industry with three main business segments: carriers' network, government and corporate business, and consumer business. The carriers' network segment includes wireless, core network, and wireline products. The government and corporate business focuses on digital transformation solutions including servers, storage, and data centers. The consumer business covers home terminals, handsets, mobile internet products, and cloud computers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary R&D in core technologies such as chips, databases, operating systems, and full-stack intelligent computing solutions. It employs advanced manufacturing and development methods including chip design, AI large models, immersive liquid cooling for data centers, and integration of 5G-A technologies. ZTE also focuses on green energy solutions, optical transmission, and digital twin technologies to enhance product competitiveness and sustainability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: ZTE serves telecom carriers, government and corporate clients, and personal consumers globally. Key industries include telecommunications, finance, power, transportation, mining, metallurgical smelting, and government affairs. The company also targets emerging sectors such as AI, digital infrastructure, and smart home applications. Major customers include large telecom carriers domestically and internationally, as well as leading internet companies and financial institutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China, which accounts for about 67.61% of its revenue, and internationally across Asia (excluding China), Africa, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania. It has a strong presence in major telecom markets including the Philippines, Indonesia, Thailand, Central Asia, Latin America, and Africa. ZTE also maintains offices and subsidiaries in Hong Kong and other global locations.
categories.supply_chain_position: ZTE operates primarily as an upstream and midstream ICT equipment manufacturer and solution provider, integrating design, development, production, sales, and services. It supplies telecom carriers and enterprises with network infrastructure, digital energy solutions, and terminals. The company maintains stable relationships with raw material suppliers and outsourcing manufacturers, ensuring a robust supply chain with global procurement and multi-base production strategies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on transitioning from connectivity to computility, emphasizing intelligent computing, AI large models, and 5G-A evolution. R&D priorities include base-level core technologies such as chips, databases, operating systems, and full-stack intelligent computing infrastructure. The company invests in green energy, digital and intelligent transformation, and open-ended decoupling technologies. It also pursues innovation in vehicular electronics, XR products, and trusted security, while fostering an open ecosphere and collaboration with industry partners.
categories.revenue_model: ZTE generates revenue primarily through product sales of communication equipment, servers, storage, terminals, and digital energy solutions. It also earns from providing integrated ICT solutions and services to carriers, government, corporate clients, and consumers. Revenue streams include sales of network infrastructure, cloud computing products, mobile devices, and software platforms. The company also benefits from investment income and financial product management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: ZTE is a leading global ICT equipment manufacturer with strong market shares in wireless and wireline networks, data centers, and consumer terminals. It holds a duopoly position domestically in core network products and maintains leadership in fixed-line network products globally. The company competes with major international telecom equipment providers and is recognized for its technological leadership in 5G, AI integration, and green energy solutions. It ranks highly in patent filings and standard-setting organizations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, ZTE reported operating revenue of RMB 121.3 billion, a slight decrease of 2.38% year-on-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 8.42 billion, down 9.66%. The company has total assets of RMB 207.3 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 72.8 billion, showing steady growth. R&D investment was RMB 25.5 billion, accounting for 21% of revenue. The company maintains a gearing ratio of 64.74% and continues to invest in strategic growth areas despite a challenging external environment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ZTE emphasizes technological innovation, proprietary core technologies, and full-stack intelligent computing solutions to deliver efficient, green, and flexible digital infrastructure. Its products are differentiated by advanced 5G-A capabilities, AI integration, energy-efficient designs, and comprehensive end-to-end solutions spanning connectivity and computility. The company offers customized solutions for diverse industry scenarios, strong global service support, and a commitment to sustainability and quality assurance, positioning itself as a path-builder for the digital economy.
